description: Hand-curated stations merged into public/catalog.json by npm run catalog. Only stations whose official stream link was checked by hand. See docs/data-source.md ("Curated stations") for the rules and how to add one.

stations.name: NOW 97.9 KBZN
stations.source: Stream URL from the station's official player at live.mystreamplayer.com/kbzn, which is linked from https://www.kbzn.com. Checked 2026-11-18: GET returns 200, Content-Type audio/aac, Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, decodes as AAC-LC 44.1 kHz stereo. Codec and bitrate from the mount name (96 kbps).
stations.coordsSource: City-centre coordinates of Salt Lake City from the Wikipedia article "Salt Lake City" (40.7608, -111.8910). These are NOT the transmitter location. The station is licensed to Ogden and its studios are downtown Salt Lake City.

stations.name: FM100.3 KSFI
stations.source: Radio Browser record b0dc24e6-1484-41e8-a18e-25f33aa4dd9c (FM100.3 - Better Music Better Work Day) with its query string removed. The directory URL carried another listener's session id and coordinates, so the clean mount is used instead. Checked 2026-11-18: GET returns 200, Content-Type audio/aacp, Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, icy-name "Bonneville - KSFIFM" (the server confirms KSFI-FM), decodes as AAC-LC 24 kHz mono. Codec and bitrate from the mount name (48 kbps). Format from Wikipedia (KSFI): adult contemporary. fm100.com returns 403 to automated requests, so it was not read.
stations.coordsSource: City-centre coordinates of Salt Lake City, the same point as NOW 97.9 KBZN (40.7608, -111.8910). These are NOT the transmitter location.
